facts.text: The CW Empower Award assists eligible first-time freshmen by covering direct tuition charges not met by federal, New York State, or outside grants.

sources.title: College Scholarships & Grants | The College of Westchester
sources.quote: The CW Empower Award For eligible first-time freshmen. The award can help cover direct tuition charges not already covered by eligible federal and New York State grants or other outside grant funding.
